chapter.title: OF OFFENCES BY OR RELATING TO PUBLIC SERVANTS

heading: “Candidate”, “Electoral right” defined.
text:
For the purposes of this Chapter—
[2][(a) “candidate” means a person who has been nominated as a candidate at any election;]
(b) “electoral right” means the right of a person to stand, or not to stand as, or to withdraw from
being, a candidate or to vote or refrain from voting at an election.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by Act 40 of 1975, s. 9, for cl. (a) (w.e.f. 6-8-1975).
